title: Teaching Experience
summary: I love sharing what I know with the next generation of truly bright students — here are some classes and seminars I've taught!

roles.title: Adjunct Professor
items: Teach CT390 Rapid Prototyping with AI, a 15-week course where students from different disciplines learn to build and ship web apps with AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.

Over the semester, students build a static site from a Figma design using MCP, an AI chat app with tool calls, an animated midterm app tested for accessibility, and a multiplayer team chat app with Google sign-in.
Built the course website and reference apps in Next.js, and run assignments and submissions through Classroom 50.

roles.title: Guest Lecturer
items: Led several sessions in the Brand Experience Design Portfolio & UX/UI Master Program on new AI techniques and best practices for various no-code website builders like Webflow, Squarespace, and Framer. Worked one-on-one with students to troubleshoot issues with their websites.

roles.title: Faculty
items: Tutored students on how to better set up their web portfolios, and provided personalized critiques on the overall structure and performance of their sites.

roles.title: Seminar Instructor
items: Designed and delivered a seminar on Selenium automation, teaching HTML DOM structure, CSS/XPath selectors, shadow DOM, and automation strategies for single-page applications.
Guided students through practical applications, including automating form submissions and file downloads.
